mapper.sql: e.id, e.order_id, o.order_no, o.store_id, s.store_name, e.user_id, u.username, u.real_name AS customer_name, u.phone AS customer_phone, e.vehicle_id, CONCAT(COALESCE(b.brand_name, ''), ' ', COALESCE(m.model_name, '')) AS vehicle_name, v.license_plate, e.rating, e.content, e.images, e.reply, e.reply_time, e.status, e.create_time

FROM order_evaluation e LEFT JOIN lease_order o ON o.id = e.order_id LEFT JOIN store s ON s.id = o.store_id AND s.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = e.user_id AND u.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN vehicle v ON v.id = e.vehicle_id AND v.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN vehicle_model m ON m.id = v.model_id LEFT JOIN vehicle_brand b ON b.id = m.brand_id
mapper.select:
SELECT
WHERE e.deleted = 0
AND e.rating = #{q.rating}
AND e.status = #{q.status}
AND (e.reply IS NULL OR e.reply = '')
AND ( o.order_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.keyword}, '%') OR u.username LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.keyword}, '%') OR u.real_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.keyword}, '%') OR e.content LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.keyword}, '%') )
ORDER BY e.create_time DESC, e.id DESC

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total, ROUND(COALESCE(AVG(e.rating), 0), 2) AS avg_rating, COALESCE(SUM(e.rating = 5), 0) AS five_star, COALESCE(SUM(e.rating = 4), 0) AS four_star, COALESCE(SUM(e.rating <= 3), 0) AS low_star, COALESCE(SUM(e.reply IS NOT NULL AND e.reply <> ''), 0) AS replied, COALESCE(SUM(e.reply IS NULL OR e.reply = ''), 0) AS unreplied FROM order_evaluation e WHERE e.deleted = 0
